content:
Apple announced multiple major Mac news today, including the new Mac Studio and Mac mini product lines.

If you're interested in picking up an Apple product launched today, you can pre-order on Amazon now.

What's new today?

The following in-depth report introduces you to the highlights of this Mac Studio and Mac mini update: equipped with brand-new chips (M6 and M5 Ultra), faster performance, providing new configuration options, and a large number of all-new AI optimizations.

  • Apple launches new Mac mini equipped with M6 and M5 Pro chips
  • Apple releases new Mac Studio equipped with M5 Max and M5 Ultra chips
  • Apple launches next-generation Apple Silicon chips: M6 and M5 Ultra

Buy on Amazon

After this morning's launch event, Amazon immediately began accepting orders for Apple's new Mac mini and new accessories.

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $899
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,099
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,699

Apple also made some small tweaks to the Magic Keyboard today, and the new model is now available on Amazon:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard $99
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID $149
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and numeric keypad (black) $199

Buy on Best Buy

  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,599

Are you planning to pick up any of the new Apple products launched this time? Feel free to let us know in the comment section.
